details:
Worlds like drinking worlds, strip club worlds, ect, should have the Adult_Content tag on their world. Simply adding a sign in the world stating it's 18+ should not give you an exemption. 

If you want content gating to work, worlds needs to have their tags set, regardless of the tags the creator made. Looking at you drinking night, which contains drug/alcohol themes which are adult oriented, not to mention more 18+ themes for spin the wheel, truth or dare, never have I ever prompts, ect. (this and many worlds like it, are shown to users whom are not age verified, and in DNs case, advertised based on VRChats own tags internal tags), example tags attached below.

The reason people run into kids in those worlds is simply because of the content being approved for all users regardless of account standing.

but if no changes are made, I guess that means I can just make adult theme'd worlds around substance us-*cough*-abuse, and sexual content open for all without content gating. 

Keep in mind, this is just being brought up for fair treatment. Cherry picking and special treatment, acceptations to the rule, eventually are gonna get abused. This isn't just for worlds, this also includes for avatars too :) since those are obviously treated harshly compared to worlds
